mil4.6:1.1: Thero sādhūti sampaṭicchitvā dasa upāsakassa upāsakaguṇe paridīpesi: Dasa ime mahārāja upāsakassa upāsakaguṇā, katame dasa: idha mahārāja upāsako sanghena samānasukhadukkho hoti, dhammādhipateyyo hoti, yathābalaṃ saṃvibhāgarato hoti, Jinasāsanaparihāniṃ disvā abhivaḍḍhiyā vāyamati, sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, apagatakotūhalamangaliko jīvitahetu pi na aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddisati, kāyikaṃ vācasikañ-c' assa rakkhitaṃ hoti, samaggārāmo hoti samaggarato, anusuyyako hoti, na ca kuhanavasena sāsane carati, Buddhaṃ saranaṃ gato hoti, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, sanghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti. Ime kho mahārāja dasa upāsakassa upāsakaguṇā, te sabbe guṇā tayi saṃvijjanti, taṃ te yuttaṃ pattaṃ anucchavikaṃ patirūpaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ Jinasāsanaparihāniṃ disvā abhivaḍḍhiṃ icchasi. Karomi te okāsaṃ, puccha maṃ tvaṃ yathāsukhan-ti.
